body:
@jimmywarting I like that UI approach.  It's a little hard to discover what the hotkeys are, but once you know it's very helpful.  And I agree that any specific choice of hotkeys should be up to the browser.

I think this proposal is complimentary to that sort of UI: it adds a way for the author of the HTML to specify a meaningful base step.  It's most useful for high-precision inputs where it takes a large number of individual `step`s to see an interesting change in the results.  You can also use it to support unusual step sizes - for example, an input in inches could have `step-hint=12` so that it increments in feet by default.
